sentence: This project builds fusion protein enzymes that shut down inflammation through metabolic reprogramming and applies them to the autoimmune disease psoriasis.
This project studies the molecular mechanisms that regulate the transport, organization and activity of voltage-gated ion channels.
This project builds base editors that change a single DNA base without causing off-target edits at neighboring bases.
This project studies how the hippocampus and primary visual cortex work together during mental simulations in the brain.
This project studies how ablative liver-directed radiotherapy overcomes immunotherapy resistance in melanoma patients and melanoma models with liver metastases.
This project builds tools for brain wide electrophysiology in freely moving mice and rats, including robotic assisted surgery and analysis software.
This project links clinical imaging, histology and molecular profiling to pancreatic adenocarcinoma subtypes and builds a non-invasive imaging test.
This project maps the structure and connectivity of the developing cerebellum to understand development after perinatal cerebellar injury.
This project builds a tool that uses machine learning to predict which older adults return to the emergency department and need a hospital admission.
This project builds artificial intelligence methods that measure heart disease from computed tomography images.
This project uses routinely collected health data to study language development in children identified as late talkers.
This project studies human genetic variants that make people more likely to develop disseminated coccidioidomycosis, using genome sequencing.
This project tries to find out how the bacteria that cause dental caries take in and use sugars to grow and produce acids.
This project studies how signaling, metabolic and neural pathways within tumors and across organ systems shape cancer and its response to treatment.
This project tries to find out how diet affects bacteriophage and microbe interactions, in order to promote colonization of a probiotic.
This project studies how circadian timing affects the blood-brain interface, using a human brain-mimicking microfluid chip.
This project develops mass spectrometry tools to study how protein amyloid fibrils begin to form and to screen for amyloid inhibitors.
This project builds a network of real-world data resources for research on Alzheimer's disease and related dementias.
This project studies how the fibroblast growth factor receptor drives breast cancer growth and progression through interactions between tumor cells and stromal cells.
This project predicts cyclic peptides that Streptomyces bacteria could make, then chemically synthesizes them and tests them for bioactivities.
